notes: New Flat edge NPZ from Edge V1-V3: velw = peak amplitude of the strongest partial within +-0.25 % of each mode, ^0.8; band envelopes in the plugin's 22 one-third-octave bands, 20 ms frames from the strike, the SPEAR band levels (loudest band = 1); the preset's edge_rms_correction divides each band by its velw norm so each band follows the SPEAR level; smoothed (30 ms) after 200 ms; extended past each capture by its late decay. Extended to 1500 frames (30 s) by each band's decay over the last 3 s of its capture (bands that die inside a capture stay silent), so the envelope window is 30 s.
